authors: Dan Boneh, Gil Segev, Brent Waters

ref_file_title: BV11 - Efficient Fully Homomorphic Encryption from (Standard) LWE
note: First FHE from plain LWE: relinearization gives a somewhat homomorphic scheme, dimension-modulus reduction makes it bootstrappable; unbounded FHE needs the additional (weak) circular-security assumption. DOI 10.1109/FOCS.2011.12. Verifier: FOCS 2011 listing and eprint number re-confirmed via web search.

note: Concurrent and independent with AJ15. FOCS 2015, pp. 171-190, DOI 10.1109/FOCS.2015.20; journal version J. ACM 65(6), 2018. cryptobib_key: FOCS:BitVai15 (verified in vendor/cryptobib/crypto.bib).

Verified independently via web search against the DBLP record journals/siamcomp/BernsteinV97 (SIAM J. Comput. 26(5):1411-1473, 1997); the paper establishes BPP ⊆ BQP ⊆ P^#P. DOI is the standard one; doi.org, dblp.org and epubs.siam.org are egress-blocked from this environment. Journal version of the STOC 1993 paper, cited as the literature usually does.

ref_file_title: BY96 - Certifying Permutations Noninteractive Zero-Knowledge Based on Any Trapdoor Permutation
note: Added by verifier. cryptobib_key: JC:BelYun96 (pp. 149-166); conference version CRYPTO 1992 (C:BelYun92). Removes FLS90's certified-permutation hypothesis for families over bit strings by certifying the index with a NIZK proof. No key collision in existing-refs.txt.

ref_file_title: Bar01 - How to Go Beyond the Black-Box Simulation Barrier
note: Bibliographic data verified against the vendored cryptobib FOCS:Barak01 (FOCS 2001, pp. 106-115, DOI 10.1109/SFCS.2001.959885); use `cryptobib_key: FOCS:Barak01`. Abstract (search snippet): assuming collision-resistant hash functions, a zero-knowledge argument for NP that is constant-round with negligible soundness error, public-coin (Arthur–Merlin) and has a strict-polynomial-time non-black-box simulator. Not an improvement of the barrier but its circumvention — the wiki has no 'circumvents' edge type and `role: improvement` is the only slot that creates the reference page. No key collision in existing-refs.txt.
Verified against the vendored cryptobib entry C:Beaver95 (pages 97-109, LNCS 963); set cryptobib_key: C:Beaver95 on the new reference page.
